routing_warnings.description: The proposed letter-based method without redlines changes the concurrence-package presentation; the license discrepancy separately belongs to REQ_NV_ELECTRICAL_PE_CREDENTIALS.
The letter-content approval and missing stamp concern documentation acceptance and the independently required PE stamp/signature, not substantive engineering review.
The request to present the previously approved statements as drawings changes the package presentation rather than the substantive electrical review.
The unresolved engineer-name placeholder concerns identifying text in the concurrence document rather than the presence of the PE stamp and signature.
The requested US date format is a documentation-format correction.
This short approval immediately follows the engineer-name and date-format corrections and is better routed as verification of the corrected documentation.
The missing PE stamp and signature reported in this message are a runtime failure of the separate stamp-and-signature Requirement.
The claim that the stamped letter was delivered is stronger evidence for application of the PE stamp than for a documentation-format transition.
In addition to changing the presentation format, this message requests application of the PE stamp to the revised callout drawings.
The statement that the drawing-format work belongs to the second milestone also provides lifecycle and scope evidence for addressing client and city comments.
The reported missing PE stamp and signature is a runtime failure of the stamping Requirement, not the comment-revision obligation.
The requested US date format is a concrete documentation-format change.
The requested detailed drawing callouts are a concrete change to the concurrence documentation presentation.
The request to stamp the callouts also affects the independently defined stamping Requirement.
The requirement to present the original-scope statements in drawing format belongs to the documentation-format Requirement.
The request to stamp the drawing-format callouts also belongs to the stamping Requirement.
This message describes the as-built baseline and amendment documentation for the contracted concurrence project, not creation of the separate project's permit drawings.
The Word-file cover-letter and redlined-PDF alternatives concern the contracted concurrence documentation format.
The requested electrical callouts are client comments on the contracted concurrence project, not the separately discussed permit package.
The request to present the original scope in drawing format is a revision responding to client or city comments on the contracted project.
The Title 24 exclusion and HVAC sizing-calculation clause concerns the separate HVAC calculation Requirement.
The Manual J, Manual S, and Manual D clause concerns the separate HVAC calculation Requirement and is not included in this Requirement's value.
This message concerns the concurrence format for the original electrical-modification project, not the separate additional permit project.
The missing stamp and signature are observed on the original project's concurrence letter.
This message requests revised stamped callouts for the original project's client comments, not the additional permit project.
This message questions license number 16119 using the Nevada PE website while discussing the original Nevada concurrence project, not the additional California permit project.
The freelancer's denial of having supplied license number 16119 occurs within the Nevada-project credential exchange and should not be forced into the California credential lifecycle.
The replacement name and license are identified for stamping the active Nevada project rather than the separately discussed California permit project.
